Say this first: Farm Tax in 30 Seconds: what a farm management deposit actually is.
Script: It's money you set aside in a good year and claim as a deduction that year. It's taxed when you take it out, ideally in a tougher year when your income is lower. The basics: at least $1,000, up to $800,000 in total, you need to be a primary producer, and your off-farm income has to be $100,000 or less. Leave it in for at least 12 months, unless an exception applies.

Say this first: There's a new tax on super balances over $3 million. Here's who it actually hits.
Script: It's called Division 296 and it started on 1 July 2026. If your total super is over $3 million, the earnings on the part above $3 million are taxed an extra 15 per cent. Above $10 million there's another 10 per cent on top. It applies to earnings you actually make, not paper gains. If you're anywhere near $3 million, especially with farm property in your SMSF, talk to your adviser. General information only.
